info.title: Siemens.AspNet.CodeRules.Cli
info.description: The 'coderules' .NET tool: runs the code rules of every code rule project of a solution from the console, without a test framework. Human console output with clickable locations, or one JSON document for AI agents, git hooks and CI.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Code rules: architecture and convention checks for a solution. 'coderules run' runs them; 'coderules [command] --help' shows the details.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

commands.name: run
commands.description: Runs the code rules against the solution and reports the findings. Default: the rules of every code rule project in the solution.

options.name: --pack
options.description: Rule pack assembly (.dll) to load instead of the code rule projects of the solution; repeatable. A pack with an ICodeRulePack decides its rules, otherwise all public rules are taken.

options.name: --project
options.description: Code rule project to use (name, '*' matches any characters); repeatable. Default: every project with <IsCodeRuleProject>true</IsCodeRuleProject>.

options.name: --rule
options.description: Rule ID; repeatable. '*' matches any characters, e.g. RECORD_*. Default: all rules.

options.name: --group
options.description: Rule group, case insensitive; repeatable.

options.name: --tag
options.description: Rule tag, case insensitive; repeatable.

options.name: --format
options.description: human: console output for people (default). ai: JSON for AI agents and scripts. [default: Human]

options.name: --no-color
options.description: Plain text without ANSI colors (also off when the output is redirected or NO_COLOR is set). [default: False]

arguments.name: SOLUTION
arguments.description: The .sln or .slnx file, or a folder with one. Default: the current directory.

commands.name: list
commands.description: Lists the rules of the code rule projects (or of the packs) with ID, group, title, tags and pack.
